The point of me getting this was to consolidate my different Google sheets, give me an overall overview of my finances, be able to check in on progress, etc. This is not it. Stunning style. However, I dislike how Actual Income, Debt Payoff, and Savings are tracked. It would be better if the 'Expenses' tab was 'Transactions' with a type for 'Income, Debt, Expense, or Savings' that logs them on the dashboards. Right now, you have to manually calculate totals and enter them. The budgeting is intuitive and easy to use. Overall, it's just okay—the lack of automation lowered my rating, though some might find it perfect. Sadly, I won't be using or recommending it unless updated to include automation for more than just expenses. It feels unfinished to me.
